_fixture: A confirmed claim goes stale under an explicit freshness policy, is refreshed, and must be re-confirmed by a person.
_why: Refresh never restores confirmed: a re-read reopens review. The fold must refuse confirmation while stale, accept it only after the refresh, and eligibility must block at the stale point.
